title: centaurium corymbosum
intro: Centaurium corymbosum, commonly known as Mountain Bluet, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of insomnia and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Centaurium corymbosum include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. Additionally, Centaurium corymbosum has been used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties.
